test_arr_min_max: test the arr.min and arr.max methods to compute minimum and maximum values from array elements
test_arr_sum_mean_var_std: test the arr.sum, arr.mean, arr.var, and arr.std methods to compute statistical aggregations on array elements
test_array_get: test the arr.get method to retrieve an element at a given index from an array with null_on_oob handling
test_array_join: test the arr.join method to concatenate array elements into a string with a separator and ignore_nulls option
test_array_explode: test the arr.explode method to expand array elements into individual rows
test_array_sort: test the arr.sort method to sort array elements with descending and nulls_last options
test_array_unique: test the arr.unique method to extract unique elements from an array while preserving order
test_array_contains: test the arr.contains method to check if an array contains a specified value with nulls_equal option
test_array_slice: test the arr.slice, arr.head, and arr.tail methods to extract sub-arrays with as_array option
test_array_to_struct: test the arr.to_struct method to convert an array column into a struct with custom field names
